name: AL-37350A
summary: AL-37350A, also known as 4,5-dihydropyrano-α-methyltryptamine (4,5-DHP-AMT), is a serotonin receptor agonist and tricyclic tryptamine derivative related to the psychedelic tryptamine 5-MeO-AMT.0 nM, and moderate selectivity over the related 5-HT2B and 5-HT2C receptors. The drug has been shown to have ocular hypotensive activity in animal models, suggesting it may be useful for the treatment of glaucoma.

pharmacology.text: AL-37350A, also known as 4,5-dihydropyrano-α-methyltryptamine (4,5-DHP-AMT), is a serotonin receptor agonist and tricyclic tryptamine derivative related to the psychedelic tryptamine 5-MeO-AMT. It acts as a potent and selective agonist for the serotonin receptor 5-HT2A, with a Ki of 2.0 nM, and moderate selectivity over the related 5-HT2B and 5-HT2C receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: The drug has been shown to have ocular hypotensive activity in animal models, suggesting it may be useful for the treatment of glaucoma.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that activate the 5-HT2A receptor, the serotonergic psychedelics, can cause altered perception, anxiety, confusion, nausea and a raised heart rate.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。活化 5-HT2A 受體的藥物，也就是血清素類迷幻藥，可能引起知覺改變、焦慮、混亂、噁心與心跳加快。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。活化 5-HT2A 受体的药物，也就是血清素类迷幻药，可能引起知觉改变、焦虑、混乱、恶心与心跳加快。

fact.en: The "AL" code comes from Alcon, an eye care company, which made this compound while searching for new ways to lower pressure inside the eye in glaucoma.
fact.zh: 代號中的「AL」來自眼科公司 Alcon，這家公司在尋找降低青光眼眼壓的新方法時合成了這個化合物。
fact.zhHans: 代号中的「AL」来自眼科公司 Alcon，这家公司在寻找降低青光眼眼压的新方法时合成了这个化合物。
